{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABepUXFA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhIKiws", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 359, "title": "Fix macOS Command-click multi-selection and simplify Graph Editor node selection visuals", "body": "## Goal

Fix Graph Editor node selection on macOS and remove redundant/confusing visual decorations. **Node selection must be communicated by the Node card's outer highlight only**, without an inserted checkmark or shifting label. Keyboard focus remains accessible but must be visibly distinct from selection.

User-reported behavior on macOS:
1. **Command (⌘)+click** does not add/remove nodes from the multi-selection, despite being advertised.
2. Selecting a node inserts a **✓** to the left of its heading even though the entire node already has a highlighted outline. The label shifts horizontally as the mark appears/disappears.
3. After selecting multiple nodes and Shift+clicking one to deselect it, its **outer selected outline and ✓ disappear but the heading retains a separate outline**, making it look partly selected. Unselected headings also appear too far left / inconsistently aligned.

## Current implementation (verified on main)

- [`extension/graph-editor.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph-editor.js):
  - OS detection uses `this.isMac = /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.userAgentData?.platform || navigator.platform)`. This is case-sensitive, so a reported platform such as **`macOS`** fails to match, causing the wrong Ctrl/Meta modifier choice.
  - Heading selection uses `event.shiftKey || (this.isMac ? event.metaKey : event.ctrlKey)`. `heading.onclick` and `heading.onpointerdown` call `selectDetails(..., extend)`, with explicit focus calls.
  - `selectDetails()` manages the multi-selection `Set`, adds/removes `.selected-node` on node cards, updates `aria-pressed`, and chooses the last remaining selected node for the Inspector.
- [`extension/graph.css`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph.css):
  - `.editor-page .selected-node` draws a prominent outer selected border/shadow.
  - `.editor-page .selected-node .graph-heading::before { content: '✓ '; }` injects the redundant checkmark and changes the heading's inline layout.
- [`extension/recorder.css`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/recorder.css) and [`extension/app.css`](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/app.css) have shared heading styles and focus-visible outlines.

## Required changes

### 1. Make modifier-based multi-selection reliable across OSes

- Fix macOS platform detection robustly (case-insensitive matching, appropriate browser platform APIs/fallback; test `macOS` and `MacIntel`). **Do not assume all platforms report `Mac`**.
- **macOS:** `Shift+click` or `Command/Meta+click` toggles the clicked node into/out of a noncontiguous selection.
- **Windows/Linux:** `Shift+click` or `Ctrl+click` does the same.
- Normal click selects a single node; preserve existing deselect/reselect and last-selected Inspector behavior.
- **macOS Ctrl+click** may invoke the native secondary/context-click action: do not hijack or break it.
- Preserve keyboard selection (including `Shift+Enter`), dragging/moving nodes, port wiring and subgraph multi-selection actions.
- Handle mouse events consistently through pointerdown/click without inadvertently initiating drag, opening a new context menu or dropping a modifier during the event sequence.

### 2. Make the selected Node's outer outline the only selection decoration

- Completely remove the `✓` pseudo-element and any selection-only injected text/icon/checkbox before the heading. **Do not replace it with another indicator.**
- Keep the selected-state styling on the **outer Node card**, as the primary visual signal.
- Ensure unselected and selected Node headings have **identical text start positions, padding and intrinsic size**. No text shifting, left indentation, reflow or height change as nodes are selected/deselected.
- Keep `aria-pressed` / accessible state correctly synchronized with actual selection, even though the visual checkmark is removed.

### 3. Differentiate keyboard focus from actual selection

- When a node is deselected with Shift/Command/Ctrl+click, its **outer selected styling must disappear completely**.
- A heading may still retain focus, but this must **not appear as a second selection outline**. Show a clear focus indication for keyboard navigation (`:focus-visible`) without introducing a misleading selected-looking border for pointer clicks. Follow browser accessibility conventions rather than removing keyboard focus entirely.
- Inspect all relevant focus rules (shared app/editor CSS and any programmatic `heading.focus()` calls), including :focus-visible behavior after modified pointer clicks. Preserve a11y and focus/keyboard operation.
- Keep Details/Settings showing the last selected (or last remaining selected) node, per [#339](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/339), without adding selection-count banners or checkmarks.

## Acceptance criteria / tests

- [ ] In Chrome on a **macOS platform identity**, Command+click toggles independently selected nodes correctly; Shift+click also works.
- [ ] Windows/Linux Shift+click and Ctrl+click continue to work, and macOS Ctrl+click does not break native secondary-click.
- [ ] Modifier clicks do not accidentally initiate a drag or lose the clicked Node selection.
- [ ] Selected Nodes are visually highlighted **only by their card outline**, with **no ✓, checkbox or duplicate heading decoration**.
- [ ] The Node heading's text position and dimensions are unchanged before/after selection and when toggling back off.
- [ ] Deselecting one of several nodes removes its entire selection highlight; it does not leave a misleading heading outline on pointer interaction.
- [ ] A meaningful keyboard focus indicator remains for actual keyboard focus, without confusing it with multi-selection; `aria-pressed` reflects actual state.
- [ ] Last-selected Inspector behavior, keyboard interaction, Node drag, connections, and Create Subgraph from multi-selection remain functional.
- [ ] Add/update automated regression tests for macOS platform detection (`macOS`, `MacIntel`), Cmd/Shift toggling, focus/selection separation, checkmark absence, layout stability, and Windows/Linux modifiers.

## Touchpoints

- `extension/graph-editor.js`: OS detection, modified heading click/pointer behavior, `selectDetails()`, heading focus.
- `extension/graph.css`: remove `.selected-node .graph-heading::before`, align selection/focus styles.
- `extension/recorder.css` / `extension/app.css`: adjust shared focus/heading styles only if necessary.
- Graph Editor / subgraph selection browser tests.

## Related issues

- [#317](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/317): previously implemented support for multi-select modifiers.
- [#339](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/339): fixed Create Subgraph placement and last-selected Inspector; **do not reintroduce a selected-count panel**.

**UI principle:** A Node's selected state should be obvious from its existing card highlight. Do not add explanatory text or redundant indicators.
